# Krueger Pottery Inc Krueger Pottery Inc is a Arts & Crafts company. Krueger Pottery Supply is a brick and mortar store that offers clay supplies, kiln repair, glazes, clay, tools, kilns, pottery wheels, extruders, slab rollers, raw materials, classes, and kiln repair. They have fast shipping and knowledgeable staff. Krueger Pottery Inc employs 1 person (-14.3% YoY, -1 person) and has an annual revenue of $18.5M. Make a left at the stop light, follow Shrewsbury to the first light which is Big Bend. Go left, and follow past Laclede Station Road and Murdoch (Stop Sign). We will be on the right side after Murdoch in the Old Orchard shopping district. (If you wish to park in back of the store you will need to make a right on N. Old Orchard and pull into the parking lot on the left, pull through the lot until you see our sign in back for 8153). Coming from the West I-44Exit at Murdoch/Laclede Station Rd. Make a right onto Laclede, stay in the right lane and make a right onto Murdoch. You will cross back over the interstate on an overpass. Follow Murdoch 1/2 block to the 3-way stop at Big Bend. Go left and find us on your right.Parking is located behind our store. Make a right on N. Old Orchard (first street on your right after your left turn onto Big Bend). Once you turn onto N. Old Orchard, make a left behind the buildings. Our back door has a large sign over it. We are in the middle of the block.
